subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Open-ended
solution:
The correct answer is: **Having no planned ending**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• An "**open-ended**" activity or situation does not have a planned ending.

 
 
• Example - *We are not willing to enter into **open-ended** discussions.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**Open-ended**" is "Having no planned ending"

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
